item.blurb: Wepinion Inc. Raises $500,000 Pre-seed. Wepinion Inc. raises $500K in a pre-seed round led by the Green Mountain Accelerator Fund to scale its social crowdsourcing decision-making platform.
Collamo Raises $600,000 Pre-seed. Collamo raises $600,000 in a pre-seed round led by Prizmatric Group to expand its content operations platform for creators and marketing teams.
Endeem Raises $2.5M Pre-seed. Endeem raises $2.5M in pre-seed funding led by Beta Boom and Auriga Cyber Ventures to provide security and identity management for enterprise AI agents.
each::labs Raises $7M Seed. each::labs raises $7M seed round co-led by Revo Capital and EBRD to expand its generative media production platform and build custom AI models.
Unsiloed AI Raises $7.5M Seed. Unsiloed AI raises $7.5M seed round led by Felicis to scale its document processing platform for AI agents.
Hone Health Raises $228M in Funding. Hone Health raises $28M Series A and $200M in growth financing to expand its physician-led longevity care and research platform.
StepSecurity Raises $20M Series A. StepSecurity raises $20 million Series A led by Elephant to expand its developer environment and software supply chain security platform.
Connect Money Raises $3.5M Pre-Series A. Egyptian fintech startup Connect Money raises $3.5M in pre-Series A funding led by Algebra Ventures, Disruptech, and Mohamed Farouk for regional expansion.
Soombit AI Raises $9.1M Series A. Soombit AI raises $9.1M Series A led by SV Investment to expand its generative AI medical imaging software into CT and MRI diagnostics.
Speakeasy Raises $18.8M Series A. Speakeasy raises $18.8M Series A led by VMG Technology to expand its AI-driven platform for live entertainment and hospitality operations.
Variational Raises $110M Series B. Variational raises $110M Series B at a $1.5B valuation led by Bain Capital Crypto to scale its on-chain derivatives trading platform.
